title: Clock Divide by 3 (50 % Duty)
constraints: `clk_out` has a period of exactly **3** `clk` periods and a **50 % duty cycle**: high for 1.5 periods, low for 1.5 periods.
Every `clk_out` edge must coincide with an edge of `clk` (rising or falling). No glitches.
Synchronous reset (`rst` sampled by the clock): `clk_out` is 0 no later than 2 `clk` periods after `rst` rises and stays 0 while `rst` is held. The phase after reset is up to you.
Must be synthesizable. Negative-edge flip-flops are allowed.
hints: With rising-edge flops only, every high time is a whole number of clock periods, so 1.5 needs the falling edge.
Make a divide-by-3 counter and a flop `p` that is high for 1 of every 3 cycles. Copy `p` into a **negedge** flop `n`. Then `p | n` is high for 1.5 cycles.
`p | n` has no glitch: when `p` falls, `n` is still high.
